filing_office: Louisiana Secretary of State, Commercial Division
filing_fee_notes: Current official domestic LLC schedule lists 125 for formation and 35 for annual reports.
registered_agent_rules: Designate an agent with a physical Louisiana address. An individual agent must be of legal age and a Louisiana resident.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: Louisiana corporation franchise tax is repealed for franchise-tax periods beginning on or after January 1, 2026. Other applicable taxes remain separate.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and appoint a Louisiana registered agent. File the annual report even when nothing changes.
common_mistake: Skipping the annual report because the business information is unchanged.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Formation and report URLs are official gateways rather than direct application screens. Exact annual-report due-date rule, direct name-search URL, formation processing time, expedite options, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed on the permitted agency sources and are null.
